# IFramework.CanvasWidth property

Width of the window overlay in CANVAS UNITS (design space) = ScreenWidth ÷ UI scaleFactor. Position and size windows in these units so they scale with the UI (WindowRect is in canvas units). For HUD sizing that must track physical pixels, use [`ScreenWidth`](./ScreenWidth.md) instead.
